title: OpEnvelope
description: The canonical append-only operation record written to the op log. Field names and types match crates/mneme_core/src/ops.rs::OpEnvelope. The envelope is the durable on-disk primitive; the typed payload lives in the base64/binary `payload` field whose decoded shape is one of the per-op-kind input schemas in this directory.

op_id.description: Stable identity of this one append; idempotency key (partition, op_id) and resolution tie-break of last resort.

actor_id.description: Who or what asserted the operation; drives content classification.

asserted_at.description: Hybrid logical clock packed as a portable i64 (upper bits physical micros, lower 12 bits counter).

payload.description: Serialised OpPayload (msgpack/cbor on disk; base64 in the NDJSON export `payload_base64`). Its decoded shape is the matching per-op-kind input schema.

deps.description: Causal dependencies, by op_id. An operation whose predecessor is absent is reported on import, not applied blind.

id.description: An Id serialised as a canonical UUID string (lower-case, hyphenated). Mneme::Id is a 16-byte value rendered via UUID; ULID input is also accepted on parse but serialised as UUID.

hlc.description: Hlc serialised as a signed 64-bit integer (i64).
